mkdir -p docs/features/greet-name && cat > docs/features/greet-name/plan.md <<'EOF'
# Plan: Optional name parameter for greet()

- **slug:** greet-name
- **approval:** awaiting-approval   <!-- awaiting-approval | approved. Only the user's explicit OK sets "approved". -->
- **feature_base:**
- **branch:** feature/greet-name (recommended)

## Goals
- `greet("Ada")` returns `"Hello, Ada!"`.
- `greet()` still returns `"Hello, world!"` (backward compatible).
- `name` can be passed positionally or by keyword (`greet(name="Ada")`).

## Non-goals
- No input validation: empty or whitespace-only names are passed through unchanged (`greet("")` → `"Hello, !"`), not defaulted or rejected.
- No runtime type checking; the `str` type hint documents the contract.
- No trimming, casing, or escaping of the name.
- No README or documentation changes.

## Checks
<!-- build fills this in from the project on its first run, and asks if something is missing. "none" means the user confirmed there isn't one. -->
- **test:** `python -m pytest`
- **lint:** none
- **typecheck:** none
- **format:** none   **format-check:** none

## Slices
<!--
Ordered vertical slices. Each one delivers a thin end-to-end piece of behavior that can be tested on its own.
status: todo | in-progress | done | flagged
base: git SHA at the moment build started this slice (set by build)
fix_rounds: 0–2 (set by build; the cap is 2)
Acceptance criteria are numbered AC<slice>.<n>, are observable, and each becomes at least one test.
-->

### slice-1: greet accepts an optional name
- **status:** todo
- **base:**
- **fix_rounds:** 0
- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - AC1.1 Given no arguments, when `greet()` is called, then it returns `"Hello, world!"`.
  - AC1.2 Given the positional argument `"Ada"`, when `greet("Ada")` is called, then it returns `"Hello, Ada!"`.
  - AC1.3 Given the keyword argument `name="Ada"`, when `greet(name="Ada")` is called, then it returns `"Hello, Ada!"`.
  - AC1.4 Given a name with spaces and lowercase, when `greet("ada lovelace")` is called, then it returns `"Hello, ada lovelace!"` (verbatim, no reformatting).
  - AC1.5 Given an empty string, when `greet("")` is called, then it returns `"Hello, !"` (passed through, no fallback).
- **Notes:** Signature `def greet(name: str = "world") -> str`. Files: `greet.py`, `tests/test_greet.py` (existing test covers AC1.1). Single slice by agreement — the feature is too small to split meaningfully.

## Log
<!-- One line per event, appended by the skills: approvals, slice starts/finishes, flags, final review. -->
- 2026-11-14 plan written, awaiting approval
EOF
